laws.rule: Since 10 August 2026, walking through Hoi An's old town is free; the old VND 120,000 ticket for foreigners has gone. Each heritage building charges VND 20,000 a person (about A$1.10, RBA rate of 30 October 2026), the same for Vietnamese and foreign visitors; under 16s are free.

festivals.what: Hoi An Old Town Night (Đêm phố cổ, a re-creation of early 20th century Hoi An) is held on the 14th day of every lunar month, the night before the full moon. Electric light gives way to candles and lanterns, the old town is quieter, and community groups perform traditional music, bài chòi (a card and song game), tuồng opera and martial arts. The calendar date moves each month.

moving_calendars: Hoi An Old Town Night: 14th day of each lunar month.
culture-cycles.note: Start and finish times are not given on the official page. Hoi An has been part of Da Nang city since the 2025 provincial merger.
